raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies. Its architecture has three layers: an Intelligence Layer (Layer 2) that acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value of tasks, and work divergence (drift). An Execution Layer (Layer 3) functions as an "Agent Factory" to automatically generate, deploy, and monitor AI agents for high-ROI opportunities, with built-in approval gates. Narma leverages existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify areas for AI intervention and assistance.

market_data.trigger_now: Enterprises often struggle with a lack of telemetry to pinpoint AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and constant drift in systems and human resources.

raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma differentiates itself by focusing on the operationalization and scaling of AI automation through its "Work Graph" approach and agent factory, rather than just building foundational AI models. It identifies high-ROI opportunities and automates agent creation, addressing the common challenges of unclear ROI and continuous system drift in enterprise AI deployments.
